description: Advance, skip, or abort a single step in an interactive Rigor workflow. Requires the workflow_id from a prior rigor_execute call started in interactive mode. Returns the updated workflow state and a poll_url for the next step.

action.description: Step action: next (run the next step), skip (mark current step skipped), abort (terminate the workflow).

feedback.description: Optional feedback forwarded to the worker when advancing to the next step. Use to inject clarifications or corrections.

name: rigor_step
title: Step through an interactive workflow
